# Club Ten

> Club Ten (topclubten.com) is a free daily football trivia game, sometimes called a "tenaball" or "ten-a-ball" quiz. Each day, for each of six Premier League "Big Six" clubs (Arsenal, Chelsea, Liverpool, Manchester City, Manchester United, Tottenham Hotspur), players try to name all 10 correct answers to a club-specific top-10 question (e.g. top goalscorers, longest-serving captains, most-capped players) with three wrong guesses allowed before the game ends.

A new puzzle is published for each club every day at midnight London time. Puzzle answers are not public — they are validated server-side and are not present in any page's HTML, JSON, or source. The game tracks each player's current streak, total games played, and perfect scores (all stored locally in the browser, no account required).

## Also known as

Club Ten is a club-specific take on the "tenaball" / "ten-a-ball" style of trivia game (naming all 10 items in a category), distinct from grid-style or "tenable"-style quiz formats. Related terms people search for: football tenaball, footy ten-a-ball, Premier League trivia game, daily football top-10 quiz.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://topclubten.com/): pick a club and play today's puzzle
- [Archive](https://topclubten.com/archive): browse and replay past puzzles
- [Blog](https://topclubten.com/blog): weekly articles on Premier League records, history, and stats
- [How to play](https://topclubten.com/how-to-play): rules and format
- [About](https://topclubten.com/about): what the site is and how puzzles are researched

- [Dutch Players at the Premier League's Big Six: Appearances and Career Highlights](https://topclubten.com/blog/dutch-players-premier-league) (26 August 2026): Dutch players' Premier League appearance records, club by club.
- [Most Expensive Premier League to Premier League Transfers of All Time](https://topclubten.com/blog/most-expensive-premier-league-transfers) (22 August 2026): every record-breaking domestic (PL-to-PL) transfer ranked by fee, club by club.
- [Brazilian Players in the Premier League: Appearance Leaders at Every Big Six Club](https://topclubten.com/blog/brazilian-players-premier-league) (17 August 2026): Brazil's most-capped Premier League players, club by club.
